{{Top|leg}}
The '''Industrial Swampfields''' was located on the outskirts of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Erglush]] on [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]]. These huge fields were used to grow the organic machines that powered the [[Ergesh]] society. An entire section was devoted to the growing of [[Starjumper]]s organic [[Starship/Legends|spaceships]]. The Industrial Swampfields employed over 2,000 Ergesh workers and farmers.
